details: Bitcoin and the broader crypto market experienced declines on August 14, with Bitcoin slipping below $63,000. This drop is attributed to falling consumer confidence, weaker retail sales, and the SEC's cancellation of a crypto regulation meeting and delay in tokenized stock trading plans.
title: Bitcoin Price Falls Amid SEC Delays and Economic Concerns

details: The U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) conditionally approved a national trust charter application for World Liberty Trust Company, linked to Donald Trump's crypto venture. This approval enables the firm to expand stablecoin operations, manage assets, and settle payments.
title: US Regulator Approves Bank Charter for Trump-Backed Crypto Company

details: Norway's sovereign wealth fund increased its indirect Bitcoin exposure by 21.2% in the first half of 2026, reaching a new all-time high of 11,549 BTC. This includes significant investments in companies holding Bitcoin, such as Strategy, Metaplanet, MARA, Coinbase, Block, and Tesla.
title: Norway's Sovereign Wealth Fund Hits Record Indirect Bitcoin Exposure

details: Cboe BZX Exchange has filed with the SEC for approval to list 3x-leveraged Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs, alongside other commodity funds. These funds aim to deliver three times the daily performance of their underlying assets primarily by holding futures contracts.
title: Cboe Seeks SEC Approval for 3x Leveraged Bitcoin and Ether ETFs

details: Binance announced it will cease processing transactions with HTX (formerly Huobi) and ten other crypto exchanges, citing compliance with EU sanctions against Russia. This move aims to prevent the circumvention of restrictions related to the Ukraine invasion.
title: Binance to Block Transactions with HTX and Other Exchanges Under EU Russia Sanctions

details: Trezor, a hardware wallet manufacturer, disclosed a data breach affecting one of its shipping providers, exposing personal information of thousands of customers in multiple countries. While Trezor's systems and devices remain secure, affected users may face increased phishing attempts.
title: Crypto Hardware Wallet Maker Trezor Reports Data Breach

details: Public Bitcoin miners are reducing their hashrate and selling BTC holdings to invest in AI infrastructure. For instance, Hyperscale Data sold 685 BTC for $43 million to fund a Michigan data center and reduce debt, signifying a strategic shift in capital towards AI-related technologies.
title: Bitcoin Miners Pivot to AI, Selling BTC for Infrastructure Development
